title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**Your Impact on Our Mission**
We are looking for a
**Senior Software Engineer**
to join the teams that build Zocdoc's provider platform — Provider Infrastructure and Provider Roster Management.
  
  
**These Teams Create And Scale The Core Systems That**

* Store and serve provider, location, and roster data as a reliable source of truth.
* Power onboarding and ongoing management experiences for practices of all sizes, from solo providers to large health systems.
* Ensure provider changes propagate quickly and safely to downstream systems like Search, Availability, Analytics, and Integrations — so patients always see accurate information.

We're building toward a future where Zocdoc can onboard and manage tens of thousands of providers under a single organisation in days, not months, with predictable performance and reliability across the stack. Your work will directly improve how quickly providers get live on Zocdoc, how confidently clients manage their rosters, and how reliably downstream experiences behave as we scale.
  
  
As a senior engineer here, you'll balance meaningful individual contribution with mentorship. You'll work across the stack — front to back and everything in between — with an emphasis on robust, observable services and high-scale data flows. You'll take ideas from inception to reality by rapidly iterating, validating with real usage, and hardening systems for long-term scale.
  
  
**You'll Enjoy This Role If You Are…**

* Excited by the challenge of scaling — passionate about building reliable systems with cloud-native infrastructure and event-driven patterns.
* A product-driven engineer who enjoys partnering closely with PM, design, Ops, and analytics to solve real customer problems.
* Motivated by building products that make healthcare easier for providers, operations teams, and patients.

* Curious about how AI and GenAI can responsibly improve developer productivity and provider experiences (e.g., smarter prefill, better insights), while staying grounded in real value.

* Using metrics, dashboards, and load tests to keep services healthy and observable as usage grows.
* Sharing knowledge and feedback to help the team move faster and make better technical decisions.

*Note: As a Zocdoc engineer, you'll have access to and be encouraged to use generative AI coding tools as part of your day-to-day workflow.*
**You'll Be Successful in This Role If You Have…**

* 6+ years of professional software development experience, with significant backend or full-stack work on distributed systems.
* Experience shipping features or services for high-scale systems — internal tools, data pipelines, or user-facing applications — where correctness, resilience, and performance matter.
* Comfort working across the stack and learning unfamiliar parts of a system when needed.
* Experience in an agile, cross-functional environment, collaborating with product, design, analytics, and operations partners.
* A track record of mentoring other engineers and raising the bar on testing, observability, and deployment practices.
* Solid communication skills and empathy for both internal users and external customers.

**Technologies we use**

* C# and .NET
* React
* AWS — DynamoDB, Lambda, SQS/SNS, Kinesis
* Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, asynchronous event processing
* AI/ML and GenAI tooling (e.g., LLM-based services, vector search, embeddings)

**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Flexible, hybrid work environment
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare reimbursement
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Sponsored counselling and therapy via Betterlyf
* Competitive PTO
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2022-2026

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. About the Role We are looking for a hands-on Data Engineer (7+years) to build and optimize scalable data pipelines and analytical datasets on the Databricks platform. You will work closely with Analytics/BI, Product, and Business teams to enable data-driven decision-making. Retail / eCommerce domain exposure is a strong plus, along with the ability to translate business needs into reliable and performant data solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks (Spark) and Python (PySpark).
* Develop and optimize complex transformations using SQL (joins, window functions, CTEs, query tuning).
* Build curated datasets and data models to support reporting, dashboards, and advanced analytics use cases.
* Implement pipeline reliability best practices: data quality checks, monitoring, alerting, and reconciliation.
* Optimize Databricks workloads for performance and cost (cluster sizing, partitioning strategies, caching, file formats).
* Work with structured and semi-structured data (JSON, CSV, Parquet/Delta) and handle schema evolution.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business KPIs and deliver data solutions aligned to retail/eCommerce metrics (sales, orders, returns, inventory, customer cohorts).
* Follow engineering best practices for version control (Git), documentation, reusable code patterns, and testing.
* Good to have: Support or migrate Alteryx workflows into Python/Databricks pipelines.

**Must-Have Skills & Qualifications**

* 7-13 years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Warehousing / Big Data.
* Strong hands-on experience with Databricks (Jobs/Workflows, notebooks, cluster concepts, Spark tuning fundamentals).
* Strong programming skills in Python (PySpark preferred).
* Excellent SQL skills, including performance tuning and writing complex analytical queries.
* Experience building scalable pipelines and working with large datasets in distributed environments.
* Strong understanding of data engineering concepts: ETL/ELT, orchestration, data validation, and observability.
* Familiarity with modern data storage formats and practices (Delta/Parquet, partitioning, incremental loads).

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Retail / eCommerce domain knowledge (customer behavior, funnel metrics, pricing/promotions, inventory, catalog, order lifecycle).
* Alteryx (workflow development, optimization, scheduling, or migration to Databricks).
* Experience with Lakehouse patterns and Delta Lake features (e.g., MERGE, OPTIMIZE, Z ORDER).
* Experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, ADF, Databricks Workflows).
* Cloud experience: AWS / Azure / GCP (S3/ADLS/GCS, IAM basics, security controls).
* CI/CD exposure for data pipelines, code reviews, and automated deployments. Preferred Traits
* Strong problem-solving skills and a mindset for root-cause analysis.
* Ownership and accountability for production-grade pipelines.
* Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfort working in fast-paced environments with evolving requirements.

description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Data Scientist (AI/ML, Python, Langchain, GenAI, Pyspark, SQL)
  
  
Lead, Data Scientist
  
  

* Our Purpose

The Business & Market Insights (B&MI) team within Mastercard's Services division creates products that help customers including financial institutions and merchants understand their customers and the market better. The B&MI Data Science team uses data from Mastercard transactions and other sources to build models and solutions that are needed for these products, at a globally scalable level across the different customer lifecycle stages.
  
  
This role is for a Data Scientist that will work across Product, Client Services & Delivery, Data & Engineering and the broader teams, to deliver truly differentiated products driven by analytics & AI, leveraging rich data resources, AI platform capabilities and near real-time execution.
  
  
We are developing multiple new products and capabilities using analytics & AI, and this role is central in that vision, from concept, technical design to market release and optimization. This role is positioned to drive new ideas forward by combining creative thought leadership with innovation and industry best practices. By entering in the early phase of a truly transformative and impactful strategic initiative, the experience is certain to be rewarding.
  
  
This role requires the successful candidate to have the following:
  
  

* 8-12 years of overall career experience in Data Science function supporting Products
* Design, develop, and productionize machine learning and data science solutions that solve complex business problems within BMI.
* Develop traditional ML solutions covering feature engineering, model training, validation, evaluation, and deployment.
* Perform exploratory data analysis and translate complex datasets into actionable insights.
* Build Generative AI applications using Python and modern GenAI frameworks, particularly LangChain and LangGraph.
* Optimize data pipelines and ML/GenAI workflows for performance, scalability, maintainability, and reliability.
* Evaluate GenAI solutions for answer quality, groundedness, reliability, latency, and cost, rather than relying solely on prototype-level demonstrations.
* Develop robust and reusable Python components following sound software-engineering practices.
* Use PySpark to process, transform, and analyze large datasets efficiently in distributed environments.
* Write advanced, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, feature development, and analytical workloads.
* Collaborate with product managers, AI engineers, software engineers, and other data scientists to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Apply appropriate controls for data privacy, security, responsible AI, monitoring, and explainability.
* Conduct code reviews, establish reusable technical patterns, and mentor less-experienced data scientists.

**The Successful Candidate’s Primary Responsibilities Will Be To**

* Drive the evolution of B&MI products with an impact focused on data science and engineering
* Participate in the exploration, application and development of data science for product development
* Participate in identification and evaluation of AI/ML techniques and tools to deliver models and analytics for product development
* Continuously innovate and determine new data science approaches & technologies to solve business problems and generate business insights & recommendations
* Partner with roles across the organization including product, engineering, and sales to determine the highest priority data science problems to solve in a customer-centric framework
* Evaluate trade-offs between many possible analytics solutions to a problem, taking into account performance, usability, technical feasibility, timelines, and differing stakeholder opinions to make a decision
* Break large solutions into smaller, releasable milestones to collect data and feedback from product managers, clients and other stakeholders
* Evangelize releases to users, incorporating feedback, and tracking usage to inform future development
* Work with small, cross-functional teams to define vision, establish team culture and processes
* Consistently focus on key drivers of organization value and prioritize operational activities accordingly
* Identify and act upon product improvement opportunities
* Provide technical leadership of junior colleagues as a senior member of the data science team, through technical and non-technical mentoring

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Business Intelligence Senior Associate
description:
**About The Role**
Your role as a Business Intelligence Senior Associate is to work with the product and machine learning team to automate the process of manual forecasting and identify the root causes. You are expected to detect anomalies/issues early, identify root causes, track revenue and spend trends on an hourly/daily/weekly/monthly basis against the forecast. Coordination with multiple teams to fix problems with rollouts/ releases and ensure leadership always has an accurate view of performance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Monitor the health of the business via tools such as our anomaly detection software and other dashboards, and keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on the health of key input metrics.
* Hourly and daily (Real-time monitoring): Monitor the hourly trend continuously.
* Revenue declines must be assessed to find the root cause and verify if the decline is associated with any product release.
* Executive Communication: Share insights and learnings on long-term and short-term trends with a broader set of stakeholders to inform strategic planning and GTM execution.
* Allocate the identified cause to the corresponding teams and assess the next actions.
* Inform the Network Operations Center team to trigger P1/P2 alerts based on the severity of the revenue decline.
* Weekly (Medium Term Monitoring): Own the revenue forecasting process and provide executive updates.
* Define variance thresholds that trigger deeper analysis to understand reasons behind movements of key dimensions.
* Investigate any metrics that show signs of decay or are deviating from the norm and find the root cause.
* Monthly (Long Term Monitoring): Lead the monthly review process with Marketplace, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to track the key drivers of our spend on an ongoing basis.
* Be intimately involved in the quarterly and annual planning process and be aware of what assumptions went into the plan.
* Act as the project manager of investigations. Cross-functionally manage workstreams with account stakeholders to complete analyses and troubleshooting.
* Provide regular updates on Steering Committees. Revenue Monitoring Process Improvement.
* Reduce “blind spots” by developing new monitoring frameworks and incorporating new data sources into existing monitoring processes.
* Collaborate with Product Management and external vendors to improve existing anomaly detection solutions, based on KPI performance.
* Rollout and Recovery Tracking: Work closely with the monetization product team to track and quantify the impact of product releases.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

* Proven 5 to 8 years of experience in data analysis, or a similar role, is preferred.
* Communication Skills - Ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise, and actionable way to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Technical skills such as Excel, Looker, MYSQL, forecasting, impact measurement, AB Testing, are a must.
* Knowledge of Excel macro/VBA, Python, and Ad Tech experience is good to have.
* Experience with GenAI-based tools like Cursor and Claude will be an added advantage.
* Strong knowledge of data manipulation and analysis.
* Familiarity with anomaly detection techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning methods, time-series analysis, and outlier detection algorithms.
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.
* Problem Solving - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work with ambiguous data.
* Attention to Detail - High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all work.
* Shift Timings - 3.00 PM to 12 midnight.
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.

**Qualifications**

* Should have a Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

title: Data Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Shelter Associates is a Civil Society Organization (CSO) founded in 1994 to improve the living conditions of the urban poor in India. The organization works toward a future where every citizen has access to basic infrastructure, secure tenure, and equitable rights. Its core initiatives focus on technology-led facilitation of essential services, with a strong emphasis on healthcare and sanitation.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Data Manager role based in Pune . The Data Manager will oversee data collection, cleaning, validation, and maintenance of databases related to Shelter Associates’ projects, including sanitation, housing, and spatial data initiatives. Responsibilities include designing data management workflows, coordinating with field teams to ensure accurate and timely data entry, and integrating data from multiple sources into centralized systems. The role involves preparing regular reports, dashboards, and visualizations to support program monitoring, impact assessment, and decision-making.

The Data Manager will collaborate closely with program staff, community mobilizers, and technology partners to ensure that data is secure, reliable, and effectively used to improve services for urban poor communities.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong data management and analysis skills, including experience with databases, spreadsheets, and data cleaning tools.
* Candidates should possess skills in data visualisation and reporting, using tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with GIS or spatial data tools, as well as an understanding of mapping and location-based data for urban development projects.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in basic statistical methods and the ability to interpret data for program evaluation and impact assessment.
* Candidates should possess strong organisational and documentation skills, with attention to detail and data quality standards.
* Relevant academic background such as a bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, urban planning, public health, computer science, or a related field is beneficial.
* Experience working with NGOs, CSOs, or social impact projects, particularly in urban sanitation or healthcare, is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Pune , collaborate with diverse teams, communicate clearly, and uphold ethical standards in data privacy and security is required.

description:
Greetings!!!

  

Please find below Job Description:

  

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a seasoned Generative AI Architect with a strong foundation in enterprise and system architecture, combined with significant depth and breadth in Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI application development. This is a senior cross-cutting role responsible for architecting, designing, and guiding the implementation of Industry AI Solutions (IAIS) across multiple teams.

The Generative AI Architect will serve as the technical authority for AI architecture decisions within their assigned teams, working alongside embedded GenAI Developers (who report to this architect for technical direction), traditional software engineers, and business stakeholders. The architect bridges the worlds of robust enterprise system design and cutting-edge AI capabilities translating business goals into scalable, secure, production-ready GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

**Cross-team Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Architect and own the end-to-end Solution Design, working alongside a System Architect or alone for an Industry AI Solution Team, ensuring architectural consistency, pattern reuse, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Serve as the primary technical authority for GenAI and Agentic AI architecture decisions within assigned teams, providing direction to embedded GenAI Developers and guiding their implementation work.
* Define and enforce architecture standards, design patterns, reference architectures, and guardrails for GenAI and Agentic AI development across teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, proof-of-concept evaluations, and technical design discussions for AI features and components.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Solution Design**

* Design scalable, production-grade GenAI application architectures including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Agentic Workflows, LLM integration layers, prompt management systems, and response evaluation frameworks.
* Architect multi-agent systems and Agentic AI workflows: agent orchestration patterns, tool use, memory management, long-horizon task execution, and human-in-the-loop designs.
* Select and evaluate appropriate LLMs, embedding models, and AI frameworks (commercial and open-source) based on performance, cost, latency, and compliance requirements.
* Define LLM fine-tuning and adaptation strategies (RLHF, PEFT, LoRA, prompt tuning) where required, overseeing implementation by the developer team.
* Design LLMOps and AI observability pipelines including evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, and feedback loops for deployed AI systems.

**Enterprise System Architecture**

* Apply deep system architecture expertise to ensure GenAI solutions integrate seamlessly into existing enterprise platforms including CRM, ERP, workflow automation tools, and analytics systems.
* Design robust, secure API layers, microservices, and event-driven integration patterns that connect AI components with enterprise backends.
* Ensure AI architectures meet enterprise non-functional requirements: scalability, availability, latency, security, and disaster recovery.
* Collaborate with infrastructure and cloud teams to architect AI workloads on cloud platforms (Azure preferred: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML) with appropriate cost and performance optimisation.

**Data Engineering & AI Data Architecture**

* Design and govern data pipelines supporting AI model inference and (where applicable) fine-tuning: ingestion, transformation, quality validation, and versioning.
* Define data architecture for AI: vector databases, knowledge graphs, embedding stores, and structured/unstructured data integration patterns.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data pipelines meet quality, freshness, and compliance requirements for AI use cases.

**Responsible AI, Governance & Security**

* Embed AI fairness, transparency, explainability, and accountability principles into solution designs from inception.
* Define and enforce AI security architecture: prompt injection protection, data leakage prevention, model access controls, and audit logging.
* Ensure compliance with applicable AI governance frameworks, data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR), and enterprise AI policies.
* Conduct AI risk assessments for new solutions and advise teams on responsible deployment practices.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication**

* Collaborate closely with executive stakeholders, product managers, business analysts, and engineering leads to align AI architecture with business strategy and product roadmaps.
* Present complex AI architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences; produce architecture documentation, decision records, and design artefacts.
* Actively contribute to the broader IAIS architecture community sharing learnings, patterns, and innovations across teams and programs.

Mandatory Qualifications & Skills

**Architecture & Engineering Foundation**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Solution Architect or Enterprise Architect (5+ years), with a track record of designing large-scale, production enterprise systems.
* Strong command of system design principles: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, API design, cloud-native patterns.
* Experience architecting across cloud platforms, with strong preference for Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure API Management).

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Expertise**

* Deep hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI application development — including RAG architecture, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and chain-of-thought design.
* Proven experience architecting Agentic AI systems and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, and LLMOps practices — including tracing tools, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring.

**Programming & Technical Skills**

* Strong Python proficiency — able to prototype, review, and guide implementation of GenAI components.
* Working knowledge of software engineering best practices: Git, CI/CD, automated testing, API design, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).

**Responsible AI & Governance**

* Sound knowledge of Safe AI principles, AI security patterns, AI governance frameworks, and data privacy compliance.
* Ability to conduct AI risk assessments and embed governance into architecture decisions.

**Communication & Leadership**

* Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions and drive consensus across multi-disciplinary teams.
* Effective at communicating architecture decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to both technical and executive audiences.
* Experience mentoring developers and guiding teams through complex AI implementation challenges.

Business Analyst, AI
  
  
So, what’s the role all about?
  
  
NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. Your idea. Our spark.
  
  
As Business Analyst in the SPARK team, you will be the bridge between the people who have the ideas and the architects and builders who make them real. You will shape raw ideas into clear, prioritised, buildable use cases, and make sure what we build solves the problem it was meant to solve.
  
  
This is a business analysis role with a technical edge. You come from a programming background, so you can read code, query data, test an API, and prototype a quick proof of concept, and you can still run a room full of non-technical stakeholders. You will work closely with the Project Manager, the AI Architects & Builders, and the Change Management & Evangelist.
  
  
How will you make an impact?
  
  
You will own the front end of the incubation pipeline, from the first conversation about an idea through to accepted, measurable outcomes, working hands-on with business teams, architects, and delivery colleagues across regions.
  
  
Discover and Shape Ideas
  
  

* Run discovery sessions, interviews, and workshops with business teams to understand pain points, current processes, and the outcome they want
* Turn ideas into clear use case briefs covering the problem statement, users, expected value, data needs, risks, and success measures
* Assess and rank ideas against business value, feasibility, data readiness, effort, and risk, and give the team a clear recommendation on what to build next
* Build lightweight business cases, including estimated time saved, quality gains, and cost or revenue impact for presentation to Management and AI steering committee

Define What Gets Built
  
  

* Map as-is and to-be processes, and identify where an AI agent, an automation, or a human-in-the-loop step fits best
* Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that architects and builders can build from without guesswork
* Specify expected AI behaviour: what the solution should do, what it should never do, when it hands over to a person, and how answers will be checked for quality
* Prepare test scenarios and evaluation datasets with the builders to measure accuracy, reliability, and usefulness before launch
* Update initiative register

Prototype and Validate
  
  

* Use SQL, Python, or low-code tools to analyse process data, test assumptions, and build simple prototypes that prove an idea before engineering effort is committed
* Review APIs and system documentation to confirm integration feasibility with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365
* Gather early user feedback on prototypes and turn it into prioritised backlog items

Support Delivery and Adoption
  
  

* Own and groom the product backlog, and take part in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives
* Plan and run user acceptance testing with business users, and manage defects and feedback through to closure
* Partner with the Change Management & Evangelist and the Support Helpdesk to turn user questions and feedback into clear improvements

Measure and Share Value
  
  

* Capture baseline metrics before launch and track results afterwards, so every solution can show real impact
* Understand the Software Development Lifecylse to review adoption, continuous business iteration and value realization.
* Maintain the use case library, requirement templates, and playbooks that make the next idea faster to shape

Have you got what it takes?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 5-8 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst in a software, technology, or digital transformation environment
* A programming background: hands-on experience writing code in at least one language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or C#, plus working knowledge of SQL and REST APIs
* Proven skill in requirements engineering: process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, and traceability from need to delivered outcome
* Experience facilitating workshops and aligning senior business stakeholders with technical teams
* Experience working in Agile teams, with tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Working understanding of how large language models, RAG, and AI agents work and what they can and cannot do reliably, with hands-on use of AI assistants in your own work
* Some finance background or knowledge will be a plus
* Strong analytical, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical ideas in plain business language
* Fluency in English

You will have an advantage if you also have:
  
  

* Hands-on experience on AI, GenAI, or automation projects, from use case definition through to production
* Experience with low-code or agent-building tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio or similar
* Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS environments
* Familiarity with evaluating LLM output quality, including test set design and acceptance thresholds
* Business analysis certification such as CBAP or PMI-PBA
* Experience working across regions and time zones, with teams in International and the Americas

**Job Description**
At Synoptek, we think globally and act locally. As the world's first Managed Experience Provider (MxP™), Synoptek provides world-class strategic IT leadership and hyper-efficient IT operational support, enabling our global client base to grow and transform their businesses. We are excited to have experienced continuous growth and, in keeping with that momentum, we are seeking to add talent to our team. When you partner with Synoptek, you engage with an ever-growing, ever-evolving IT organization that provides a high-caliber team, drives growth, and delivers clarity. This is an exciting opportunity for you to be a part of this journey!!
  
  
The Functional Consultant – Dynamics AX is responsible for supporting the implementation, configuration, optimization, and functional consulting of Microsoft Dynamics AX and Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations solutions aligned with business and operational requirements. This role collaborates closely with project managers, solution architects, technical consultants, business stakeholders, and client teams to deliver scalable ERP solutions that support enterprise transformation initiatives and operational process improvements. The position participates in business process analysis, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, solution validation, testing activities, documentation, training support, and client engagement activities while ensuring alignment with delivery methodologies and client expectations.
  
  
**Mandatory Skills**
Microsoft Dynamics AX,Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations,ERP Functional Consulting,Business Analysis,Requirements Gathering,Gap-Fit Analysis,Business Process Documentation,Workflow Documentation,Functional Specifications,Process Mapping,production Planning

* Support the implementation, configuration, and optimization of Microsoft Dynamics AX and Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations solutions based on business and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with project managers, solution architects, technical teams, and client stakeholders to support ERP project delivery activities.
* Participate in discovery sessions, business process analysis, requirements gathering, gap-fit analysis, and scope confirmation activities.
* Document business requirements, workflow diagrams, process maps, functional specifications, meeting notes, and operational procedures.
* Facilitate workshops, user discussions, demonstrations, and solution walkthroughs with client stakeholders.
* Assist in configuring ERP modules, workflows, reports, dashboards, forms, and operational process configurations where applicable.
* Support solution validation, testing activities, quality assurance processes, user acceptance testing, and issue resolution efforts.
* Collaborate with technical consultants to ensure business requirements are translated effectively into functional and technical solutions.
* Support organizational change management activities, user enablement initiatives, training coordination, and go-live support activities.
* Assist with ERP data validation, migration support activities, reporting validation, and administrative support where applicable.
* Participate in Agile project delivery activities including sprint planning, backlog refinement, project coordination, and delivery support tasks where applicable.
* Support project management activities as needed including coordination, status tracking, follow-ups, and risk identification.
* Maintain awareness of Microsoft Dynamics AX and Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations platform capabilities, business process improvement opportunities, and industry best practices.

**Job-related Experience**

* Experience in ERP consulting, business analysis, enterprise application support, or functional consulting environments is preferred.
* Experience supporting Microsoft Dynamics AX or Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations implementations, business process documentation, workshop facilitation, workflow analysis, testing activities, and client-facing project engagements is preferred.
* Experience supporting consulting practice or professional services engagements is preferred.

title: Engineer L1
description:
**About Us**
We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
  
  
Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
  
  
We are looking for an Oracle IT Analyst with hands-on functional experience beyond end-user activities, who is motivated to build and grow a long-term career working with Oracle E-Business Suite.
  
  
In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver stable, scalable, and business-aligned Oracle solutions that enable efficient Procure-to-Pay and Order to Cash operations and continuous process improvement.
  
  
This job is based in Pune- Maharashtra - India.
  
  
We provide a flexible working schedule with the option of working hybrid.
  
  
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be**
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from stakeholders and translate them into functional specifications for Oracle E-Business Suite.
  
  
Design, configure, and support Oracle R12 SCM /Distribution modules, including Purchasing, Order Management, iProcurement, Inventory, and iSupplier, Shipping , WMS , Pricing ensuring correct setup of profile options, flexfields, and business rules.
  
  
Map existing (“as-is”) business processes, perform gap analysis, and design optimized (“to-be”) processes aligned with Oracle EBS capabilities.
  
  
Create and maintain functional documentation, including scope documents, functional design documents, use cases, process flows, and user training materials.
  
  
Develop and execute functional test scripts and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
  
  
Provide end-user training and ongoing functional and technical support, including issue resolution and management of Oracle Service Requests (SRs).
  
  
Act as a key liaison between business users and technical teams, ensuring effective communication and successful delivery of IT solutions.
  
  
Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process efficiencies and system enhancement opportunities.
  
  
**For This Role You Will Need**
University degree in Information Technology, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field.
  
  
3-5 years of hands-on experience with Oracle E-Business Suite R12, with strong functional expertise in Distribution (Procurement/Order Management) modules.
  
  
Solid understanding of the Procure-to-Pay (P2P)/ Order to Cash(O2C) lifecycle and related supply chain business processes.
  
  
Experience with at least one end-to-end Oracle implementation or multiple Oracle Procurement support projects.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
  
  
Experience creating functional documentation and process maps.
  
  
Working knowledge of SQL for querying tables and reading packages.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart**
Functional knowledge of ASCP AND Manufacturing modules.
  
  
Experience working in a global or cross-functional environment.
  
  
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels.
  
  
Proactive, pragmatic, and results-oriented mindset.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Our People**
Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
  
  
Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
  
  
Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!
  
  
**Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging**
At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Founded in Zurich in 2005, peoplefone started as a bold idea to transform telecommunications — and we’ve been growing ever since. Now active in

www.peoplefone.com**

We are looking for a Senior API Product Engineer to design and develop customer-facing APIs as reliable, secure and easy-to-use products. This is not only a backend development position. You will work with product teams, internal developers, customers, and integration partners to understand their use cases, determine which capabilities and data should be exposed, and translate those requirements into clear and evolvable API contracts.

You will own API design from the initial use case through contract definition, implementation, documentation, testing, publication and lifecycle management.

**Your impact:**

* **Understand real usage**
  – Gather and challenge API requirements together with customers, partners, product owners and internal teams, and understand how their developers will consume what we expose.
* **Design contract-first**
  – Design every API using a contract-first approach with OpenAPI: agree resources, operations, schemas, error models, pagination, filtering, idempotency and async patterns before implementation starts, and use the contract as the source of truth for docs, mocks and tests.
* **Decide what's exposed**
  – Work with product, architecture and security to decide what data and operations may be exposed, and translate business capabilities into intuitive, consistent API resources and workflows.
* **Build production-grade APIs**
  – Implement and maintain the REST APIs you design, with clean versioning, deprecation and backward-compatibility strategies so partner integrations never break unexpectedly.
* **Secure by design**
  – Define authentication and authorization, scopes and roles appropriate to customer- and partner-facing use cases.
* **Enable integrators**
  – Create accurate documentation, examples and reference integrations, and support customers and partners directly during their integration work.
* **Close the loop**
  – Establish automated contract, integration, security and performance testing, and feed real API-consumer feedback back into the design.
* **Raise the bar platform-wide**
  – Define API design guidelines and reusable standards that other development teams adopt.
* **Work as one team**
  – Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives, with code reviews, pair programming and CI/CD as standard practice.

**What You Bring**

***The Must-Haves:***

* 8+ years of backend software engineering experience, including significant time designing and building APIs in production
* Hands-on experience defining API contracts with OpenAPI/Swagger, and comfort treating the spec as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought
* Proven ability to design resources, schemas, versioning and backward-compatibility strategies for APIs consumed by external customers or partners — not only internal services
* Solid understanding of API security fundamentals: OAuth 2.0/OIDC, scopes, roles and data-exposure controls
* Confident handling of relational databases and writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code (automated unit/integration tests as standard practice)
* Experience working directly with customers, partners or third-party integrators to gather requirements and support their integration work
* Self-organized, a strong communicator, and comfortable owning a feature or capability from initial use case through go-live
* Good written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear developer-facing documentation

***Nice-to-Haves:***

* Telecom/VoIP domain experience.
* Experience with PHP 8.x, Laravel & OOP
* Frontend experience (Vue 2/3, CSS, React)
* Familiarity with contract/schema testing tools (e.g. OpenAPI diffing, Spectral, contract test frameworks)
* Experience with containers and CI/CD pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI)
* Monitoring stack exposure: Grafana, Prometheus, OpenSearch
* Atlassian tooling: Jira, Confluence.
* Agile mindset and experience with Scrum methodologies

* Career Growth opportunities into an evolving team
